entries.text: That’s the second signboard. Bit tricky to find,\nhuh?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_01

entries.text: S-sorry... I’m followin’ at a distance, so...I...I hope\nyou can get used to me showing up like this.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_02

entries.text: Now then, let’s read the sign...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_09

entries.text: The ogre possessed four mysterious, glimmering\nmasks.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_system_01

entries.text: It is said that depending on the mask the ogre\ndonned, the powers of its cudgel would change.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_system_02

entries.text: When wearing the teal mask, it could bring life\nback into withered greenery around it.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_system_03

entries.text: When wearing the crimson mask, it could turn a\ncandle’s flame into a raging inferno.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_system_04

entries.text: When wearing the blue mask, it could stop the\nvery flow of a river.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_system_05

entries.text: When wearing the ashen gray mask, it could\neasily break the hardest stone in two.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_system_06

entries.text: Before the Loyal Three fell, they wrested away\nthree of the ogre’s masks, greatly weakening it.
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_system_07

entries.text: The masks the Loyal Three stole are kept over at\nKitakami Hall.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_32

entries.text: Everyone in town is scared of the ogre...but me?\nI really like it.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_14

entries.text:
It was strong...and cool...and it didn’t even care
when everyone shunned it...\c
I’ve always wanted to be like that, ever since I
was a kid.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_15

entries.text: I want to be as cool as the ogre.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_33

entries.text: My sis sorta ends up doin’ everything for me...\neven when we’re at school...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_34

entries.text: I...wanna try to get stronger. So I can do things\nfor myself, you know?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_35

entries.text: I’m gonna become someone people can rely on.\nThen, just maybe...I could be that ogre’s friend.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_36

entries.text: Oh! Um...right. Picture. We’re s’posed to take\na picture![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_16

entries.text: You can take the next one, too, if you don’t mind,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_17

entries.text: Phew. I knew it was the right call to let you\nhandle it, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_18

entries.text: Now, on to the next signboard...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_37

entries.text: Oh. And you know the mountain the stories say\nthe ogre lives on? It’s actually Oni Mountain.\r\nYou can climb it from the stairs over there.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_38

entries.text: If you wanted, we could...go see the ogre’s\nhome? Folks call it the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Dreaded Den[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_39

entries.text: Y-yes! I really...wanted you to see it for yourself,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_40

entries.text: You don’t have to if you don’t wanna...but...\nI’d really like to show you it. You know?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_41

entries.text: So...if you keep climbing up, you’ll reach the\nInfernal Pass. There’s a sign before that... If you\r\nturn at the sign, you can get to the Dreaded Den.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_42

entries.text: S-so I’ll just head on up, then. Come along when\nyou’re ready. An’ be careful![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_side01_020_brother_43
